answer: Because the timing is published against the sable challenge, the saffron audit can replay the copper history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 93 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 1014 identities would post 3600 proofs and burn roughly 46 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
